scripts.dev: vp exec dotenv -e .env -- vp pack --watch --on-success "node --enable-source-maps dist/main.mjs"
scripts.dev:inspect: vp exec dotenv -e .env -- vp pack --watch --on-success "node --enable-source-maps --inspect=9231 dist/main.mjs"
scripts.start:dev: vpr build && vp exec dotenv -e .env -- node --enable-source-maps dist/main.mjs
scripts.openapi:generate: vpr prisma:generate && vp pack scripts/generate-openapi.ts --out-dir dist-openapi --no-sourcemap && node dist-openapi/generate-openapi.mjs && vp fmt --write openapi.json
scripts.prisma:push: vp exec dotenv -e .env -- vp exec prisma db push
scripts.prisma:seed: vp exec dotenv -e .env -- vp exec tsx prisma/data/main.ts
scripts.prisma:seed:menu: vp exec dotenv -e .env -- vp exec tsx prisma/data/menu/seed.ts
scripts.prisma:seed:role: vp exec dotenv -e .env -- vp exec tsx prisma/data/role/seed.ts
scripts.prisma:bootstrap-admin: vp exec dotenv -e .env -- vp exec tsx prisma/data/bootstrap-admin.ts
scripts.prisma:studio: vp exec dotenv -e .env -- vp exec prisma studio
scripts.prisma:migrate: vp exec dotenv -e .env -- vp exec prisma migrate dev
